grammar.title: Around a time with 前后
grammar.explanation: 前后 (qiánhòu) after a time word or festival name means "around, or so" — showing the event happens close to that point, a bit before or after. It comes right after the time expression.

sentences.en: Around Spring Festival, he's always at home.

sentences.zh: 十点前后，他给我打了电话。
sentences.pinyin: Shí diǎn qiánhòu, tā gěi wǒ dǎ le diànhuà.
sentences.en: Around ten o'clock, he called me.

sentences.zh: 生日前后，他收到了很多礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Shēngrì qiánhòu, tā shōudào le hěn duō lǐwù.
sentences.en: Around his birthday, he received a lot of gifts.
